_about: Public-domain John Cuthbert Hedley (1837-1915, Benedictine, Bishop of Newport) for the Word Hoard: 4 books from Internet Archive scans: The Spirit of Faith (1875), Lex Levitarum with St Gregory's Regula Pastoralis (1905), The Holy Eucharist (1907) and Our Divine Saviour and Other Discourses (third edition, no year on the title page). Written in English. Added 2026-10-18 by lane A, round 28 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
